tasks.answer: List container = UiList (export UiList, import from '@/components/ui/navigation'); cell row = UiCell (export UiCell, import from '@/components/ui/navigation'). Both are shared-ui exports from the same module: import { UiList, UiCell } from '@/components/ui/navigation'.
Export FlightDelayEventDetailScreen; import { FlightDelayEventDetailScreen } from '@/features/flight-delay-compensation/event-detail-screen'; required prop: eventId.
Export FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen; import { FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen } from '@/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen'; required prop: batchId.
Export AuthRecoveryDialogView; import { AuthRecoveryDialogView } from '@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog-view'; required prop: detail.

Export BookingStatusBadge; import { BookingStatusBadge } from '@/features/traveler-bookings/BookingStatusBadge'; no required props (value is optional; null renders --, unknown codes render their string form).

notes: Strict catalog-only: one search per task (5 total), no get, no second search, no source/config/help/ls/cat/grep/file reads. All tasks resolved from catalog metadata only. D1: UiList is the list container and UiCell the cell row; both are exported from the shared module '@/components/ui/navigation'. D5: the catalog component for traveler booking status codes is bookings.BookingStatusBadge (export name BookingStatusBadge, not TravelerBookingStatusBadge), chosen as the direct match from the single search. D2-D4 required props are eventId, batchId, and detail respectively.
